plan.title: Route remaining task fragments through xbrief layout resolver

narratives.Description: After the vbrief/->xbrief/ rename (#2109), task fragments for reconcile-issues, issue-ingest, project-render, and roadmap-render still hardcoded the vanished vbrief/ directory path, causing all four verbs to fail on migrated trees. This fix routes each verb through the layout resolver (prefer xbrief/, fall back to vbrief/ for unmigrated trees), consistent with the #2132 spec/prd fix.
narratives.Acceptance: task reconcile:issues, task issue:ingest, task project:render, and task roadmap:render all resolve xbrief/ on migrated trees and no longer error with 'vbrief directory not found'. Release dry-run passes cleanly.

items.title: Update reconcile-issues and issue-ingest to derive vbriefDir from projectRoot via layout resolver
Add --project-root support to roadmap-render and project-render CLI entries
Update task fragments to pass --project-root instead of hardcoded vbrief/ paths
Add tests for --project-root on migrated xbrief and legacy vbrief trees
